description: Zero-dependency Python library to check whether a file extension or path is a text file type, with a frozenset of 300+ known text extensions (source code, markup, data and config formats). Python port of the text-extensions npm package.
rules: Import from text_extensions: is_text_extension, is_text_path, TEXT_EXTENSIONS, TEXT_EXTENSIONS_LOWER.
is_text_path checks only the file name; a path without an extension (for example Makefile) returns False.
